title: DescriptionList
description: Labeled metadata fields rendered as a native dl; rows stack on narrow screens.

support.notes: Data object in Vue (like React): an item of the parent component's items / entries prop.

api.notes: Data object in Vue (like React): an item of the parent component's items / entries prop.

props.name: bordered
props.description:
Frames the list as a card (full border, rounded corners, surface
background, padded rows)

props.name: striped
props.description: Tints every other row (replaces the row separators)

vars.name: --description-list-row-padding-y
vars.description: Vertical padding of a row (follows the density's row padding)

vars.name: --description-list-gap
vars.description: Space between the term and the description

vars.name: --description-list-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of a bordered list (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --description-list-background
vars.description: Background of a bordered list (defaults to --surface-color)

vars.name: --description-list-padding-x
vars.description: Horizontal padding of the rows of a bordered or striped list

vars.name: --description-list-stripe-background
vars.description: Background of every other row of a striped list (defaults to --surface-subtle-color)

translationResources.title: DescriptionList
translationResources.description: Labeled metadata fields rendered as a native dl; rows stack on narrow screens.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Labels and values accept any ReactNode, and 0 is rendered.

variants.title: Bordered and striped
variants.description: bordered frames the fields as a card with padded rows; striped tints every other row instead of drawing separators.

DescriptionListProps.bordered: Frames the list as a card with padded rows
DescriptionListProps.striped: Tints every other row (replaces the separators)

DescriptionListItem.key: Stable React key of the row
DescriptionListItem.label: Term, rendered in a <dt>

cssVars.--description-list-row-padding-y: Vertical padding of a row (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--description-list-gap: Space between the term and the description
cssVars.--description-list-radius: Corner radius of a bordered list (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--description-list-background: Background of a bordered list (defaults to --surface-color)
cssVars.--description-list-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the rows of a bordered or striped list
cssVars.--description-list-stripe-background: Background of every other row of a striped list (defaults to --surface-subtle-color)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Declarative <minerva-description-item label> rows; the content (text, badges, links) goes into the <dd> of a native <dl>.

items.title: Rows from data
items.description: The items property renders rows from JS data, before the declarative children; 0 is rendered as a value.

styling.title: Styling
styling.description: CSS variables set the density, gap and separators; ::part(term) and ::part(row) style the native cells.

variants.title: Bordered and striped
variants.description: The bordered and striped boolean attributes: a card frame with padded rows, or tinted alternate rows instead of separators.

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.
